archive.content: publicly exportable tracked Git content at the selected commit only, applying committed export-ignore attributes

componentInventories.reason: The source checkout contains these manifests, but no Desktop bundle is an asset of this source-alpha release.
Worker lockfiles are source evidence only. No worker image, layer, package installation, or microVM artifact is covered.

exclusions.literal: No OCI image, image layer, base image, provider image, container runtime, operating-system package, apt package, apk package, Python wheel, or registry artifact is covered.
No Desktop .app, helper binary, downloaded Node runtime, Codex runtime, ACPX runtime, code-signature, notarized package, or platform bundle is covered.
No node_modules tree, cache, dist output, state/local content, Docker volume, persisted project, provider result, or live engineering evidence is covered.

Provider-specific internal prompting, local agent configuration, and command pointers retained by the private development checkout, including .grok/**, .claude/**, .cursor/**, .codex/**, and CLAUDE.md, are excluded from the public source archive. AGENTS.md, .agents/skills/**, and .github/** remain public.
Private design history under docs/assets/** and docs/rfcs/** is excluded from the public source archive. Living Diátaxis documentation and contributor-facing media under docs/media/** remain public.
This inventory does not prove that any provider, local worker, microVM, Docker topology, Desktop shell, or engineering operation is installed, runnable, qualified, or available.
